label: Shielded — the whole length of it
location: The Sunken Mire, over the deepest pools
injuries: Harrowed hide from blows taken holding position over the deepest pools

recentEvents.value: It put its whole length between the intruder and the deepest spawning pools and did not move. The small things went quiet behind it.

unresolvedConflicts.value: A foot in the spawning pools is the one intrusion it cannot absorb.
